purpose: Hand-written, fully analysed sentences for the sentence parser (for cases the sentence machine does not make well), including sentences with two finite verbs.
details: Loaded by kern/taal/nagekeken.py (PAD). Sentences use the bracket notation read by kern/taal/zinnen.lees_haakjes. Each item has a school year ('jaar' 4, 5 or 6), a tense ('tijd' tt/vt), the finite verb in the other tense ('anders', for the tense check), and optional flags: 'wie' (the direct object is a person, so the tip asks 'Wie ...?'), 'vz' (aan or voor for the indirect-object question), 'naam' (the first word is a name and keeps its capital). 'twee' has sentences with more than one finite verb: only pv and o are marked, with '|' between the clauses and /ww on verbs that are not the finite verb. Mixed into series according to the learning line parameters nagekeken and twee_pv.

field_notes.explanation: The list of single-clause sentences (40), each with jaar, tijd, anders, zin and optional flags.
The list of sentences with two finite verbs (26), each with tijd and zin.
